findings.detail: Rows 317432 through 317442 have blank accession_number even though the source filing metadata provides accession 0001803498-26-000014.

rationale: C006 is a row-level traceability check for accession_number. The validation artifact reports eleven filing-derived BDC rows with observed accession_number blank, but the raw source metadata for the same Blackstone Private Credit Fund 2025-12-31 10-K exposes accession 0001803498-26-000014. Because the source accession is available and the extracted rows failed to carry it, this is a real extraction/traceability data error rather than a false alarm.
